turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes before a client call. You asked for this meeting, so go ahead.
Okay. Owen found out about a zero from the gradebook on his phone, in the middle of class. Why didn't anyone call me first?
I admire how you fight for your kids. I'd have wanted a mom like you.
Don't manage me, Hale. Answer the question: why didn't anyone call me before that zero went in?
We really want the same thing here, you and me. We're on the same team.
Then why are we here? Nobody called me before that zero was entered, and I'm still waiting for you to tell me why.
So as teammates, can we just move forward?
Not until the zero is withdrawn, Hale. Forward starts with you answering who decided to enter it, and when.
